digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and provenance tracking
propositions: Signed verdicts currently record only a model string and do not distinguish between first-class and best-effort providers or capture the actual endpoint used, preventing consumers from identifying provider source or tier

An additive, backward-compatible provider_provenance record must be assembled from primitives and stamped into verdicts at assembly time without recomputing the already-resolved ModelCapabilities record
The provenance record (provider, model, endpoint_host via hostname-only extraction, tier, capabilities) must not leak credentials and must be persisted in all three sidecar payloads
Verdicts assembled by finalize_verdict must receive the already-computed provenance from runner results via explicit wiring in orchestration layers rather than recomputation or cfg-derivation
A legacy sidecar payload lacking provider_provenance must still load and verify, and credential material from base_url or api_key must never appear in the persisted signed payload
